abstract: Human chorionic gonadotrophin (HCG) was measured in sera from seminoma patients by an immunoassay which recognised both free beta-chains and intact HCG molecules. This seemed to increase the sensitivity of the assay without affecting its specificity. The HCG values were correlated to the clinical course in 151 patients. Pre-orchiectomy samples were assayed in 57 patients. Elevated pre-operative HCG levels were found in 15 of 38 patients (39%) in stage I and in 13 of 19 patients (68%) in stages II to IV. After orchiectomy the HCG values were normal in 114 of 115 patients in stage I and elevated in 13 of 36 patients (36%) in stages II to IV. Relapses were observed more often in stage II to IV patients who produced HCG at the time of diagnosis than in non-producers (3 of 13 patients versus 1 of 23 patients). In 7 of 11 relapses the serum HCG was elevated. HCG positive relapses were seen in patients both with and without initially elevated serum HCG.
abstract_ja: 血清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を、遊離βサブユニットと完全なhCG分子の両方を認識する免疫測定法で測定した。この方法は特異性に影響を与えることなく感度を高めると思われた。151例のhCG値を臨床経過と対比した。精巣摘除術前の検体は57例で測定された。術前のhCG高値は病期Iの38例中15例(39%)、病期II〜IVの19例中13例(68%)で認められた。精巣摘除術後、hCG値は病期Iの115例中114例で正常、病期II〜IVの36例中13例(36%)で高値であった。hCG産生を示した病期II〜IV患者では、非産生例より再発が多かった(13例中3例対23例中1例)。11例の再発のうち7例で血清hCGが上昇していた。診断時に血清hCGが高値でなかった患者にもhCG陽性の再発が認められた。
